fix: Segments are contiguous ranges of run.glyphs, so no Vec is needed: track `start` and the segment colour, and on a colour change or at run end emit `Arc::from(&run.glyphs[start..i])` (one allocation, no per-run Vec, no Vec->Arc double copy). Change push_glyph_segment to take `glyphs: &[GlyphPosition]` and do `glyphs: Arc::from(glyphs)`. The same Vec-then-into pattern repeats in push_colored_line_runs (lines 459-470) and should get the same change.

image_repeat_destinations (tree/rendering.rs:321) returns Vec<Rect> and allocates `vec![destination]` even for ImageRepeat::NoRepeat, so every painted Image allocates every frame. Either return `impl Iterator<Item = Rect>` from it, or in this arm add a non-allocating fast path: `if matches!(repeat, ImageRepeat::NoRepeat) { cache.push(PaintCommand::Image { image: image.clone(), source, destination, sampling }); } else { for destination in image_repeat_destinations(...) { ... } }`.

Every frame for every TextField this builds the display string (`"*".repeat(len)` for obscured fields, a full text clone while preediting) only to compare it with the placeholder. Put the cheap test first so the display is never built for non-empty values: `let shows_placeholder = value_empty && with_text_field_display(controller, placeholder, obscure_text, |display| display == placeholder.as_str());`. Both operands are pure, so the result is identical.

Allocates per decorated run per line per frame. Use a fixed array with a count (at most three positions): `let mut positions = [0.0_f32; 3]; let mut count = 0;` and `positions[count] = ...; count += 1;`, then iterate `&positions[..count]`.

TextLineRef::selection_spans (incular-text engine.rs:94 / geometry.rs:218) returns a fresh Vec<(f32, f32)> for every decorated run on every line each frame. Add a visitor or buffer-filling form in incular-text (for example `selection_spans_into(&self, start, end, out: &mut Vec<(f32, f32)>)`, or a closure form) and reuse one scratch Vec owned by the paint path, cleared per call. The fix lives in incular-text; this call site is where the cost is paid.

selection_rects (tree/text.rs:1799) returns Vec<Rect> and is allocated every frame while a SelectionArea selection covers a Text. Make it return `impl Iterator<Item = Rect> + '_` (the body is already a flat_map chain), or push straight into the DisplayList with `&mut DisplayList`. The same applies to the call at line 220 inside the TextField arm.
